name: Kimi Code
notes: Membership subscription with no per-token prices; each model carries the list prices of its Moonshot pay-as-you-go API equivalent (from models.dev), so Cost is what a request would cost there. The base URL is the api.kimi.com host. The docs also list an api.kimi.ai host and an Anthropic-compatible endpoint; this Provider uses neither. Context sizes are what a live GET /models on api.kimi.com reports. The auth header is not stated; bearer is what the OpenAI-compatible endpoint implies. Tools and structured output are not stated per model, so they come from models.dev. The docs require third-party tools to send their real User-Agent. The OAuth Login data (auth hosts, client id, CLI version) is that of the official Kimi Code CLI, from its MIT-licensed source; see ADR 0012. Terms risk: OAuth Login presents the official Kimi Code CLI's identity, which Kimi's Membership Benefits page says is a violation, and API key use is permitted only for coding agents. Release dates come from models.dev (https://models.dev/).

upstreamModels.name: K3.1 Pro
upstreamModels.notes: 1,048,576 is the context Pro and higher plans get; lower plans get 262,144, and an operator on one may lower the context size. Thinking required. Prices are Moonshot API list prices for kimi-k3.1-pro. maxOutputTokens is the Moonshot API ceiling for kimi-k3.1-pro (models.dev agrees for Kimi Code). tools and structured-output come from models.dev.
